notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
rpcclient provides direct RPC access to SMB services. With null session (-U '' -N), allows unauthenticated interaction when server permits. enumdomusers lists users+RIDs; queryuser retrieves detailed account info per RID.

=== RID CYCLING ===
Even when enumdomusers is blocked, queryuser 0x1f4 (decimal 500 = Administrator) through 0x44C (1100) enumerates all accounts. RID 500 = built-in Administrator, 501 = Guest, 1000+ = created accounts.

=== USEFUL COMMANDS ===
enumdomusers → list all domain users + RIDs
queryuser <RID> → full account details: description, last login, bad password count
enumdomgroups → list domain groups
netshareenumall → list all shares
getdompwinfo → password policy
